title: 2002 – The 1st WTIA Panel Discussion: Inter-Operator SMS
author: hkwtia
plainText: Representatives of mobile network operators discussed the feasibility of transmitting SMS between different operators in the panel discussion of Wireless Technology Forum organized by WTIA in 2002.
